integrity: An explicit 120-orbit twelve-class incompatibility partition proves the upper bound; an explicit 12-orbit compatible code proves the lower bound; two standalone methods check both.
scientific_limitations: Exact for length five only; no minimum-Hamming-distance, thermodynamic, homopolymer or sequencing-error assertion; finite certificate does not classify every optimum or certify historical priority.
title: Exact capacity of strand-invariant, GC-balanced, non-overlapping DNA five-mers
